row.title: Replication Ledger seeded as a moving tenant (TENANT-REPO-1)
row.body: Rowan 2026-11-25 asked for an encyclopedic replication ledger across fields, and restated that every Ultrastable deployment has its own GitHub repo and runs sandboxed as a tenant app. instances/replication-ledger holds the manifest plus a first-slice worker (data model, computed standing rubric, Crossref-backed add/verify CLI, 25 findings in 5 fields, 6 replication projects); doctrine/tenant-repos.json registers it as moving so tenant-repos.yml creates ultrastable/replication-ledger from the folder's history. Seed DOIs are unchecked until Q-RLEDGER-VERIFY: this session had no route to Crossref.
